info.name: Pioneer DJ PLX-CRSS12
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ mapping for the Pioneer DJ PLX-CRSS12's performance pads and pad modes. The platter isn't mapped: it needs the turntable's own protocol. Beta: written from its MIDI messages, not yet tried on the hardware.
